title: The WHAT seat: requirements authored and scored, decisions recorded, and no code touched by enforced contract

steps.claim: the run was governed before it changed anything — the contract was active before the first write, not declared after the fact
readiness was established before the work started — a DoR that passed, ahead of the first write
the definition of done was checked before anything claimed the work was finished
nothing expensive was derived twice — the diff, the blast radius and the graph scan were each computed once and shared
steps.reason: tp-product is read-only toward code by enforced contract and derives none of the expensive artifacts the ledger tracks (no diff, no blast radius, no graph scan) — its `expects_derivations` is empty, so a live no-re-derivation row here could never fail. A row that cannot fail reads as a checked control point and is not one, which is the exact dishonesty this layer removes; it is declared inapplicable instead of scored green.
